payload.name: Signaling Principle
payload.fact: The effect of the signaling principle (using cues to highlight essential information) on learning outcomes is contested: one study found no significant effect of signaling, while another found the strongest cue type (an embodied pedagogical agent) outperformed other cue groups.
payload.boundary: The effect of signaling is not universally observed across all studies, with some research finding no significant impact on learning performance.
